## What people already know

Introduce the familiar idea, behavior, or problem. Give readers enough context to follow the note.

## What is surprisingly new

Explain the central insight. Describe how it works, and use a concrete example or analogy when helpful.

## Why it matters in practice

Explain what this makes possible, when it is useful, and any important limitation or takeaway.
